# Bundled libraries

Copies of the libraries the game uses, so it runs without downloading anything (and inside the desktop app).

- `three.min.js` and the post-processing files: [three.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js) r128, MIT License
- `peerjs.min.js`: [PeerJS](https://github.com/peers/peerjs) 1.5.4, MIT License
- `fonts/`: [Chakra Petch](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Chakra+Petch) and [Inter](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Inter), SIL Open Font License 1.1
